caption.text: Most Postgres outages are not the query planner — they are a forgotten replication slot quietly eating the disk until the primary PANICs. This handbook walks the whole durability path: WAL records and LSNs, checkpoints and full-page writes, streaming replicas, the five synchronous_commit levels, slots, logical decoding, recovery conflicts, and failover without split brain. Ten pages of field notes, including the three checklist queries worth pinning above your monitor.
